_comment: TEST 01 -- 1969 Marin Renaissance Faire venue as a frontier town.
Source: Doerr Tapatalk thread #391 (1969 program, four Sept weekends), #663-664,
#718; venue per Wikipedia + Marin Magazine: fall NC Renaissance Faire at China
Camp State Park (San Rafael/Marinwood) 1967..~1970, then Black Point, Novato.
Sep 27 1969 (Berryessa day) was a Saturday faire weekend.
Adds the venue as a frontier town: its place-value row gives the calibrated
drive time to all four scenes. Budget: attack ~18:15-18:20; latest departure
from the faire = 18:15 minus that drive time minus ~15-20 min to change at the
lake. Kobek claimed the event 'began at 4pm and the timing would not work out'
-- verify hours in the program PDF (fairehistory.org RPFN-1969) before trusting 4pm.
cross_check extended so the run log verifies the venue against OSRM.
Venue confirmed by Barkan (2022, quoting Kobek's research):
'a very large Renaissance fair ran the weekend of the murder, an hour and a
half drive from Lake Berryessa. It was a place where thousands of people
dressed up. It was plausible for Doerr to be there.'
'An hour and a half drive' matches China Camp (this test), not Black Point.
